newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Bank of Korea to supply 1.6 trln won to banks.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Korea to supply 1.6 trln won to banks.

text.p: The Bank of Korea plans to supply 1.6 trillion won to banks through repurchase agreements maturing on November 4 to help ease a liquidity shortage in the money market, an official at the central bank said on Thursday.
"Some banks now have difficulty building daily reserve requirement levels. Today's money supply will help ease the short liquidity situation," said the official at the bank's money market department.
Market sources said cash demand has been growing from companies for payment of taxes and wages towards the end of the month. -- Seoul Newsroom (822) 727-5646
